mechanical support of a load during maintenance access

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: loss of containment at HO-9402 during shift handover

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control LIFTING_GEAR_INSPECTION: the inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear on HO-9402 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on HO-9402 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and executing a lift, specifically selecting and inspecting lifting gear. HO-9402 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during shift handover while the inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear had degraded below its design intent. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 15 October 2015 an incident occurred on HO-9402 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during shift handover, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
